summary: The sketch toolbar draws with Select, Line, Arc, Polyline, Rectangle, Circle and Slot, with the L, A, P, R, C and O shortcuts. Line makes one line from two clicks and stays active. Arc takes the start, the end and a point on the arc, and adds its own center point. Polyline replaces the separate Polygon and Path tools and keeps the path tool id: it draws line and three-point arc segments, closes when a click returns to its start, finishes open with Enter or Finish polyline, and keeps Close with line. Create relations now starts on for every drawing tool. A snapped point gets its own new point, attached by a removable coincident, point-on-line or fixed-axis relation, so drawn geometry stays connected for the solver and follows when the geometry it snapped to moves. Polyline no longer reuses the existing point identity, and unticking the box still places positions only and releases pending attachments. Slot takes both arc centers and then a width click at twice its distance from the center line, and draws two lines, two arcs and their centers, held by four tangent joints and one equal radius. Sketches that store profiles instead of graph geometry still save a slot profile centered between both arc centers, and a line-only polyline there still saves as a polygon profile. The segment mode button keeps its visible text Line and is now named Line segment, so it is not confused with the Line tool.
warning: No breaking change for installed posts, machine packages, saved revisions, CAD files or controller output. Saved slots, polygons and paths open and build as before and are not migrated. New slots in graph sketches are saved as lines and arcs with tangent and equal-radius relations instead of one slot profile, so they offer point and edge editing instead of the slot length, width and angle grips. Because Create relations now starts on, new rectangles, circles and slots that snap to existing points, lines, the origin or the axes get removable relations by default, where they previously copied positions only. A polyline that snaps to existing points adds new points and coincident relations instead of reusing those points. Untick Create relations to place positions only; relations can be removed like other relations.

checklist.schema: No UPID, post, machine package, execution plan, saved revision, CAD schema, storage, journal or worker reply change. New geometry uses the existing sketch graph points, lines, arcs and tangent-joint, equal-radius and coincident relations. Post engine API remains 1 and saved-job engine remains 3.
checklist.events: No execution event, cancellation or input-version behavior change. WebMCP tools keep their arguments and result fields; agents author the same graph geometry with append-sketch-entities.
checklist.capabilities: No post or machine capability change. The CAD sketch toolbar adds Line and Arc, merges Polygon and Path into Polyline and changes how Slot is drawn. Create relations starts on, so snapped drawing points attach by default.
checklist.auditAndOutput: No generation, audit, numbering, encoding, line ending, feed or controller-file change.
checklist.installationAndStorage: No installed package, revision, browser-cache or folder storage change. Existing slot, polygon and path profiles are read and saved unchanged.
checklist.verification: cadFreshSketchDrawing.test.ts checks the line, arc, polyline and slot graphs, their relations, picks and rejected degenerate input. cadPathDrawing.test.ts, cadPathDraftGraph.test.ts, CadSketchPathDrawing.test.tsx and CadSketchCanvasPicking.test.tsx check polyline drafts, closing on the start, open finishing, attachments and the profile fallback. CadWorkbench.test.tsx checks the toolbar order and shortcuts, two separate lines, an arc with its own center attached to a line's ends by default, rectangles and slots drawn on the origin keeping it fixed, a free polyline drawn with relations off, and polyline closing and open finishing. The canvas tests check that Create relations starts on, that unticked picks stay position-only and that unticking releases pending attachments. cadEditPreparation.test.ts checks with the real solver that an attached arc follows a moved line end. e2e/cad-sketch-constraints.spec.ts and e2e/cad-workflow.spec.ts draw with Polyline in Chromium, including trim and delete repairs that attach new edges with coincident relations. The full Vitest suite, lint, ui:check, build and the release check.

publicNotes.summary: New Line and Arc tools, one Polyline tool and a three-click Slot.
changes: Line draws one line from two clicks and Arc draws a three-point arc with its own center; both stay active for the next shape.
Polyline replaces Polygon and Path. Click the start to close it, or press Enter or choose Finish polyline to keep it open.
Slot takes both arc centers and then the width, and draws lines and arcs that you can dimension and move.
Create relations is now on by default: points you snap to existing points, lines, the origin or the axes attach with removable relations and follow that geometry. Untick it to place positions only.
publicNotes.compatibility: Installed machine packages, posts, saved revisions, CAD files and controller output are unchanged. Slots, polygons and paths saved earlier are not changed.
